# Vertex Autograph

> Vertex Autograph is a luxury high-rise residential project by Vertex Homes Pvt. Ltd. in Gopanpally, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It offers 3 & 4 BHK apartments of 2,235–3,140 sq.ft in one iconic tower with Wing A and Wing B, beside the 2,300-acre green sanctuary of HCU (University of Hyderabad), fronting a 150-ft wide main road, about 8 minutes from Wipro Circle, Gachibowli. Status: launching soon; GHMC approvals secured; excavation underway.

## Key facts
- Project: Vertex Autograph
- Developer: Vertex Homes Pvt. Ltd.
- Location: Gopanpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500046, India
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9h4DUBSjwcLra7hx9?g_st=awb
- Type: High-rise luxury apartments (one tower, Wing A & Wing B)
- Configurations: 3 BHK and 4 BHK (some 4 BHK with powder room)
- Sizes: 2,235 – 3,140 sq.ft
- Approvals: GHMC approved
- Construction status: Excavation works actively underway
- Homes: Exclusive corner residences; exclusive lift access to every residence
- Clubhouse: Privately positioned above the stilt level
- Road: 150-ft wide main road facing
- Nearby: Adjacent to 2,300-acre HCU campus; 8 min to Wipro Circle, Gachibowli; close to the IT corridor

## Pricing (per sq.ft, INR)
- OTP (limited-period offer): ₹6,499 + floor charges & East-facing charges
- EOI: ₹7,999 (PLC), ₹5 Lakh booking amount; exclusive EOI benefit and preferred unit allotment
- Launch price: ₹8,899 (PLC)

## Unit mix (typical floor)
- Wing A: A1 4 BHK 2,670 sq.ft West · A2 4 BHK + Powder Room 3,030 sq.ft East · A3 4 BHK 2,660 sq.ft West · A4 4 BHK 2,660 sq.ft East · A5 4 BHK + Powder Room 3,140 sq.ft East
- Wing B: B1 4 BHK + Powder Room 3,140 sq.ft West · B2 3 BHK 2,480 sq.ft East · B3 3 BHK 2,235 sq.ft North · B4 4 BHK 2,670 sq.ft East · B5 4 BHK 2,950 sq.ft North
